name: Crop Protocol
description: The growing recipe for one variety. Inputs only — every number here is something an agronomist knows, never something the system derives.

fields.label: Variety
fields.description: Base variety (Athena), not a length grade (Athena-60cm) — the plant makes stems, grading splits them afterwards

fields.label: Crop Type
fields.options:
Rose
Spray Rose
Summer Flower
Other

fields.label: Expected Reject %
fields.description: Share of cut stems that fail grading

fields.label: Weeks to First Bending
fields.description: Planting to primary bend — builds the framework

fields.label: Weeks to Second Bending
fields.description: Weeks after the first bend. Production is counted from here.

fields.label: Productive Life (Years)
fields.description: How many years this variety stays in the ground. Drives the multi-year budget.

fields.label: Weeks Between Cuts
fields.description: Regrowth period: a cut stem back to harvestable

fields.label: Stems Per Plant, First Harvest
fields.description: The first wave off a newly bent plant

fields.label: Stems Per Cut
fields.description: Harvestable stems returned per stem cut. Breaks are 2-3; only the ones making grade are counted here.

fields.label: Max Stems Per Plant Per Cut
fields.description: Canopy ceiling. Without it the multiplier compounds forever.

fields.label: Grade Mix
fields.description: How a plant's stems split by length. Seeded from actual harvest - see Calibrate.

fields.label: Growth Stages
fields.description: Stages offered when scouts sample a bed
